items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I needed a saxophone player. That's why I'll never forget Harry. I went by Brady. ... Brady played. Yeah.

ctx.x: Little John played trumpet. He was out in California and I didn't make him recording. So, to fill out the engagement, Harry and myself, we helped out. Now, Harry bought his guitar, he bought his trumpet. And, uh, Chuck became angry because of the fact that he felt that Harry shouldn't have bought his guitar. Well, that Harry's a good fortune if he can play two or three instruments. And, uh, he became angry to Nick's dad. So, when this New Year's job came up, I had called Harry and told him to tell him, Eddie and…

I know him. He and I worked together at the other end for years. In other words, I broke him in at the other end. Oh, really? Yeah. I was thinking now. So, Brady bought me by Harry's one night. We got on the phone and we called and called. A lot of boys was afraid to come to Mississippi. Naturally afraid. We didn't want to come. We got on the phone. Yeah. So, the wind up, he sent his cousin, Leo. Leo Montrell. Yeah.
